narrative.overview: Owner-approved visual polish implemented in src/popup/ on 2026-10-03. Midnight desk remains the default alongside Slate workspace and Signal panel. Subjects lead, account identity wraps, native actions occupy a separate footer and Settings controls are quieter. Fresh real-account acceptance remains pending for this candidate.
keyCharacteristics: Three remembered palettes with Midnight as fallback.
Separate rounded mail cards beneath slim full-address account headings.
Normal-case system typography, authored SVG icons and quiet timestamp metadata.
Immediate state changes without ambient motion.

rules.name: The Complete Palette Rule
rules.body: Switch every semantic role together, including native color scheme, selection, focus, caret and scrollbar colors.

rules.name: The Plain Label Rule
rules.body: Use normal-case system UI text; do not inherit uppercase, widely tracked comparison-board lettering.

rules.name: Account ownership
rules.body: Keep one full-address heading per account and separate rounded messages beneath it; never combine mailboxes.

dos: Do apply the active theme to every surface and interaction color.
Do preserve full account identity, native keyboard controls and visible focus.
Do render external mail as text and keep expanded preview display-only.
Do use synthetic account addresses and message content in design examples.
donts: Don't combine messages from different accounts into one account panel.
Don't introduce uppercase tracked labels, glyph toolbar icons or ambient motion.
Don't add later-stage mailbox write controls to the Stage 1 component set.
Don't treat synthetic screenshots as real-account acceptance.
